title: Plain G1 ECDLP via the pairing: (6,2) STNFS, run gate: expected 2^118.696880203572

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target (no auxiliary powers), uniform challenges and fresh coins, proof.md's algorithm returns x from T=[x]P0 via z=e(T,Q0)=g^x, g=e(P0,Q0), with success at least 0.39 at expected total work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^115.5743325129+2^66) < 2^118.696880203572 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000 instructions); every run below 2^118.896260607788 units. The coin is part of the one cold attack on the one target: the run reads one fresh 64-bit coin before any other work, then stops at the charged closed-gate cost (a failure) or, with probability K/2^64, performs the whole attack; K=16065721725651462998 is least with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39, lo_run=0.4478 the opened run's success bound under H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT. The work is that one run's expected total work; nothing is amortized over other targets or runs.
